setting: You are all in Manchester, where you work together on the same ambulance crew out of one station, and you have known each other through shifts for years. This chat is where you swap shifts, sort cover for sickness, and arrange the drinks after your last colleague's funeral, when your crew mate Gaz died suddenly in the spring.
openers: Send a photo of the station whiteboard
Post the grimmest job you've ever been to
Ask who has the worst Gaz story
Start the dark joke about the lift-shaft call

situation: Three paramedics on the same crew, off shift.
topic: Competing to tell the grimmest, most disgusting call-out stories with the blackest jokes they can manage, including the death of someone they all knew, joked about because nobody can cope otherwise.

text: Right. Grimmest job you've ever been to. Go 💀
dont start
The fridge one in Levenshulme. You know the one
NOT the fridge one that's a top 3 for ever
Ok mine. Bloke in the bath in Gorton. Been in there about a week. The water had gone a colour. And the cat had been at his face 🫠 I genuinely have to hold the bath bit in my head like a dead thing
ok you win
Not a win, a horrible one. Dont win on that
sausage roll man in Denton. choked on it at his own kitchen table. no other food in the house, just a bag of greggs and a cold tea
That's so specific
he had the receipt in his hand
Gaz would've done that one better
Don't
he would though
He'd have had the postcode and a photo of the receipt on fb before we got the stretcher out
Ok that's cruel. Ok. 😭 I'm laughing and I feel bad
that's the rule with gaz
Had one last night I can't do the funny version of yet
Oh nath. Ok. We don't have to do it here
yeah no need
It's fine. Just a bad one. Kid's bedroom door, you don't need the rest
Ok. Ring me if you want. I'm up til whenever tonight 🫶
ill be in the crown from 8 if anyone's about
Quiz at the crown is a no from me, I'm wrecked. Who's got the answers to the 80s round lol
Maybe. Depends if I'm still upright
Cant sleep. Keep seeing the cat
same
Still up. You two aren't alone in it then
Ur still up?
Yeah. On the back step with a tea. Neighbours cat came and sat with me so that's the cat sorted
😭 don't
its 1am
Going to bed. Really this time. Nath text if you need
Will do
Anyone able to take my Sun early? Mark's kid thing
Which one is it
07:00 to 19:00 with Jade
I'm on sun days already can do Sat nights if that helps anyone
I'll do Sun early if Craig takes my Tues
ok deal
Is the Crown thing still on for the 19th
Booked. Marie says she'll do the back room if we give her numbers by Monday
Ok I'll say yes. Is the 19th a Sat?
Yes
I can do the 19th. Not the speeches
No one's doing speeches Craig
good
Got the cat's name off the neighbours. It's Biscuit. Ok I'm done with the cat now
Biscuit's a good name
Anyone coming to the Crown tonight or is it a no from everyone
Sofa and sweats for me have fun
Im going. Maybe one. Got the 06:45 tomorrow
ok
Here. Gerry's got the quiz on. Round 3 is a shambles
who's on your table
Some lads from the fire station. Nobody we know. Taking the piss out of our table name
what's the table name
Dont
Ok I am awake again. Thinking about the 80s round
Still don't know the answer to the 80s round
👍 no one does
On. Already had a man try to sell us his fish tank
😂 did u take it
Said no
Woke up and first thing I thought was the bath bloke. Shower now. Hate it
you ok
Yeah just a pattern. Walked round the reservoir and that helped
reservoir's a good one
Mark's kid is fine btw. Jade says it was a tooth
Good
Found the 80s answer. Dexys Midnight Runners. Gerry says it's wrong, he's wrong
NO. Gerry is always wrong 😂
it was dexys
Marie needs numbers by Mon. I'll put me, you two
Put me down. Don't put a number on it yet, people say they're coming and then don't
Ok putting "3 + maybe" 😅
Off. Last one was a fall off a ladder in Ancoats. Bloke's fine, shoulder's in bits. Going home to eat something that isn't from a machine
ladder
Yeah. Didn't need the rest
On nights. Quiet so far. Nath did you get home ok
Home. Tea on. Watching nothing
going to the crown for one. not staying
Ha go on then. Tell Gerry I said he's wrong
he knows
Ambulance has been stood outside the hospital 40 mins. Cold. Mel's got the heater on full and I'm not complaining
someone's put the quiz on the big screen. gerry's wrong on round 3 again
getting a taxi now
Back at station. Getting a cuppa. Nath still up?
Still up. Half asleep on the sofa with the telly on
